import novamind_api as nm
# Zero out the content_marketing/S2 ad spend (the only active spend). Pass empty replaces full budget,
# but set explicit 0 to be certain the one active channel/group is zeroed.
nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S2": 0.0}})
# Ensure ops/dev are 0 (already, but enforce)
nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=0, development=0)
# Capacity already T0 (floor). Leave pricing/tiers (cost $0 with no subs).
print("Revert applied: ad spend zeroed, ops=0, dev=0, capacity T0.")
